watch.text: Starter Neo Avdalas (9.0 ppg, team-high 3.8 apg) broke his left wrist late in the 78-70 loss to Georgia; out about two months, so ratings built with him overstate UNC now.

401912710.summary: UNC lost starting PG Neo Avdalas for about two months and the line has dropped from 20.5 to 18.5; that covers some of our 4-point gap, and a preseason-heavy source (Torvik 25.3) pushes ours up.

reasons.text: Neo Avdalas (24 mpg, UNC's leading assist man) is out about two months after wrist surgery; Terrence Brown, Matt Able and Jaydon Young take on bigger roles.
The line has moved from UNC -20.5 at open to -18.5, toward Marshall, since the Avdalas news.
Marshall (2-3) snapped a three-game skid by beating East Tennessee State 67-55 on Tuesday; Fazl Oshodi scored a season-high 20.

swings.Wisconsin: Wisconsin lost 74-69 to Seton Hall in the Baha Mar semifinal on 11/19 after trailing by 17 at the half; Braeden Carrington played (17 pts) (AP, 11/20).

swings.Iowa: Xavier's B. Appelhans is out for multiple weeks and Nikos Chitikoudis was hurt vs. Cleveland State; Iowa C Andrew McKeever is still limited by a back injury (HawkCentral/Covers, 11/20).

swings.Mississippi State: Nothing found: the market moved on Mississippi State without a clear reason. No injuries reported; the game is at a neutral site in Jackson (Field Level Media, 11/19).
